summary: Household Indian brand origin stories like Parle-G and relatable cash facts generated the highest view counts and engagement, whereas abstract foreign economic theories like hyperinflation struggled to hook viewers. High-performing Shorts leaned heavily on specific rupee figures and famous daily-life products right in the opening frame. Moving forward, the channel should focus strictly on iconic Indian brand rivalries, daily cash mysteries, and tight looping hooks while eliminating vague titles or duplicate uploads.
do_more: Focus on iconic Indian brands like Nirma, Pulse Candy, Old Monk, and Bisleri that trigger immediate nostalgia and recognition.
Include sharp numerical contrasts (such as ₹10 to ₹7000 Crore) in the first two seconds of the script and title.
Structure scripts around a clear strategic conflict, such as tax loopholes, marketing masterstrokes, or brand rivalries.
Ensure every script loops seamlessly by making the final sentence complete the opening hook phrase.
avoid: Avoid vague titles like 'asli sach!' that fail to highlight the specific brand or financial figure immediately.
Avoid uploading duplicate videos or re-uploading identical scripts within short time intervals.
Avoid complex foreign monetary stories like hyperinflation in Zimbabwe that lack relatable Indian context.
Avoid slow opening commentary or intros; jump directly into the core financial anomaly in second one.
hook_tips: Start with a high-stakes financial mystery: 'Kya aapko pata hai ki ₹10 ki chai kaise banayi ₹1000 Crore ki empire?'
Use a shocking currency fact: '₹500 ke note ko chhapne me RBI ka sirf ₹2.70 kharcha hota hai!'
Name the legendary Indian brand instantly: '1977 me jab Coca-Cola India se bhaag gayi, tab Thums Up ne kya kiya?'
Lead with a counter-intuitive business move: 'Nirma ne Surf Excel ko harane ke liye TV ads nahi, ye desi trick use ki!'
title_tips: Combine recognized Indian brands with exact financial numbers: 'Bisleri Kaise Bani ₹7000 Crore Empire? 😱 #Shorts'
Highlight surprising business strategy decisions: 'Nirma Ne Surf Excel Ko Kaise Haraya? 🧼 Money Facts #Shorts'
Frame financial what-if questions clearly: 'Agar Sabko ₹1 Crore Mil Jaye Toh Kya Hoga? 😱 #Shorts'
